Bab el-Mandeb.explanation: narrow sea passage key to world shipping

NATO.explanation: Western military alliance; attack on one is attack on all

minority government.explanation: most seats but no majority on its own

referendum.explanation: a public vote on a single question

ICC.explanation: International Criminal Court, the world's war crimes court

valuation.explanation: what investors say the whole company is worth

AI agents.explanation: AI tools that take actions on their own

Series C.explanation: a company's third big funding round

GTM.explanation: go-to-market, how companies sell and market

OT security.explanation: protecting factories, power plants, physical infrastructure

securities lending.explanation: big investors lending out stocks or bonds for a fee

fusion.explanation: making energy the way the sun does

electoral threshold.explanation: minimum vote share needed to win any seats

coalition.explanation: group of parties that together form a government

enrichment.explanation: turning uranium into nuclear fuel or bomb material

Strait of Hormuz.explanation: narrow Gulf waterway a fifth of world oil passes

midterms.explanation: US congressional elections halfway through a president's term

IPO.explanation: initial public offering, listing on the stock market

mega-round.explanation: a funding round of 100 million dollars or more

cold start.explanation: time an AI chip sits idle while a model loads

firewall.explanation: device that guards a company's network

ransomware.explanation: hackers lock your files and demand payment

golden share.explanation: special government stake with veto rights

old masters.explanation: major European painters from before about 1800
